page: Microsoft Azure M84pds_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine built on the arm64 architecture and managed via Microsoft Hyper-V. The instance provides 84 dedicated vCPUs alongside 1344.0 GB of system memory, maintaining an allocation ratio of 16.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core. This hardware profile addresses workloads requiring large memory footprints without auxiliary graphics hardware, operating with a zero-GPU configuration.

Local high-speed ephemeral capacity is integrated directly into the instance through 4724 GB of bundled NVMe SSD storage. The inclusion of substantial local solid-state storage minimizes reliance on remote network volumes for swap, caching, and temporary scratch space. The virtual machine also supports Azure Premium Storage for persistent disk requirements.

From an operational perspective, the arm64 architecture combined with a dedicated vCPU model provides predictable compute execution alongside high memory density. This design yields strong resource efficiency for enterprise deployments that process large datasets in memory. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating standard virtual network configurations for ingress and egress routing.

Microsoft Azure M84pds_v4 is well tailored for enterprise in-memory databases, large-scale caching engines, real-time analytics platforms, and intensive transactional database workloads that require high per-core memory capacity alongside rapid local NVMe temporary storage.
